name: San Diego Fire-Rescue Cadet Program
org: San Diego Fire-Rescue Department (City of San Diego)
what_you_do: Learn firefighting skills in classes taught by SDFD staff, such as hose lays, ladders, search and rescue, CPR and first aid. Certified cadets can do ride-alongs with fire crews. A one week academy runs each summer.
who_can_apply: Ages 16 to 21 with at least a 2.0 GPA. The page does not name a city residency rule.
pay_detail: Not stated; described as a youth program
duration: Ongoing. A one week Cadet Academy is held each summer.
deadline_text: New cadets are accepted quarterly. No dates are posted.
how_to_apply: To get on the waitlist, email sdfdcadets@sandiego.gov. Give your name and date of birth, and say that you want to join.
